es.title: Karlos Arguiñano, 77 años: "Desayuno un café con leche, pan con aceite de oliva y fruta y hago 45 minutos de estiramientos. Me levanto a las 06:30"
es.description: Karlos Arguiñano lleva más de tres décadas despertando a media España con una sartén delante, pero su día arranca mucho antes de encender un fuego. Recién hecho los 78 años, sigue grabando a diario, se levanta a las 06:30 y desayuna siempre lo mismo. Su primera comida no admite sorpresas: "me levanto a las 6:30 horas de la mañana y desayuno un café con leche, un trozo de pan con aceite de oliva virgen extra y una fruta", según recoge ABC Gente. Después del café toca la parte gimnástica: 45 minutos de tabla de gimnasia y estiramientos nada más salir de la cama, con la elasticidad como meta, y luego lo grande: 10 kilómetros a pie por la playa o los montes de Zarautz, una hora y media a buen ritmo, sin auriculares y sin nadie al lado. "Todos los días camino 10 kilómetros, solo y en silencio", resume el cocinero en el texto de ABC. En Directo al Paladar Ángela Quintas, experta en nutrición: "Si tomas fruta en el desayuno, tienes que poner bastante jamón en las tostadas" El paseo, según ha contado, sirve para ordenar ideas y darle vueltas a recetas. Que nadie imagine al chef encendido desde el minuto uno: él mismo confiesa que hasta las 10:00 es "un zombi" por la casa, hasta que el desayuno hace efecto. ¿Y ese café de las seis y media, vicio o vitamina? La respuesta oficial le sonríe: lo fija la EFSA desde 2015, afirmando que hasta 400 miligramos de cafeína al día no suponen problema serio para un adulto sano, unas cinco tazas de café. El café con leche de Arguiñano ni roza el techo. Con el pan y el aceite, la cosa tiene más truco: la base es sólida (la grasa monoinsaturada del AOVE es de lo mejorcito del menú), pero el clásico español tiene detractores. La nutricionista Elena Garrido, que lo contó en Trendencias en agosto, avisa de que con harina refinada el desayuno pierde densidad nutricional y el cuerpo vive de picos: "solo estamos teniendo picos de azúcar", dice, con su bajada por debajo de lo normal dos horas después. Su parche: proteína y vegetales en la tostada, porque "la gente desayuna postre", remata en el mismo reportaje el doctor Gerardo Ochoa. El plan, en realidad, vale para casi todo el mundo con dos ajustes. Quien vigile sus picos de glucosa, que mire el pan antes que el café: la harina refinada, explica Garrido, se comporta como azúcar aunque encima haya una grasa saludable. Integral en vez de blanca, y la fruta entera (con su fibra) en vez de exprimida. En Vitónica El desayuno que toma cada día Karlos Arguiñano para empezar el día con la máxima vitalidad a sus 75 años Ahora bien, ¿los 10 kilómetros? Lo curioso es que el chef camina bastante más de lo que la ciencia considera rentable: una revisión publicada en Lancet Public Health en julio de 2025, con 57 estudios, concluye que las grandes mejoras llegan con 7.000 pasos diarios: 47% menos de riesgo de muerte por cualquier causa frente a los 2.000 del sedentario medio. Es decir: la constancia pesa más que la épica. En el análisis por edades, el beneficio cardiovascular de los mayores de 65 años asienta cerca de los 5.400 pasos. El chef, con los suyos, va sobrado. El resto lleva la cuenta en el móvil, sin playa de por medio. Para que te hagas una idea de lo replicable que es el método Arguiñano: la mitad fácil del plan es justo la que promete el titular. Café con leche, pan con aceite de oliva y fruta de temporada caben en cualquier cocina a primera hora de cualquier día. Los 10 kilómetros son cosa del chef. El objetivo práctico, el que fija la ciencia, se queda en 7.000 pasos. es.title: Ni cultivar ni criar ganado: el oficio que un joven agricultor recomienda para emprender en un pueblo
es.description: La profesión agrícola que recomienda Berto, conocido como @agriberto11, es la de plomero, para instalaciones y servicios relacionados. Lo describe como una opción para quienes buscan empleo en el pueblo y sugiere instalar los sistemas de riego y asegurar que las explotaciones agrícolas cuenten con el personal necesario para hacer funcionar sus instalaciones. Considera que es posible que quienes tengan la actitud adecuada se formen para prestar el servicio y sean capaces de ejecutar las tareas. Al afirmar que “si lo haces medio bien, te va a funcionar seguro”, Berto subraya la relación entre su recomendación y sus propias experiencias vitales, y recuerda que hace falta formación para montar los sistemas cada vez más automatizados que requieren los agricultores. El agricultor cita, como ejemplo de empresa de servicios de riego, a iRiego, una empresa cuyas instalaciones visitó y que, según explica, da empleo a 100 personas. Tras conocer una de las comunidades de regantes que gestiona la empresa a través de una visita a las instalaciones, Berto asistió a una gala en la que se reconocía el mérito de los agricultores y el personal de servicio, entre otros. Fue entonces cuando reflexionó sobre la opción de ofrecer servicios relacionados con las necesidades del campo. La oportunidad, según él, reside en atender a quienes cultivan la tierra con el objetivo de que sus instalaciones funcionen, lo que permite no tener que dedicarse a la agricultura como fuente de ingresos mientras se lleva a cabo el mantenimiento de las instalaciones. En Xataka En Extremadura ya hay "perros-robot" patrullando los viñedos, recopilando datos y ayudando a los agricultores El servicio de mantenimiento y la formación La idea resulta aún más clara cuando se analiza el servicio de asistencia que presta iRiego, tal y como se describe en su explicación sobre las averías por tormentas. En ella se afirma que el servicio, con personal de guardia las 24 horas del día, se dedica a gestionar las estaciones de bombeo. Los técnicos intentan resolver las incidencias por vía remota y acuden al lugar de trabajo para resolver problemas que no puedan solucionarse a distancia, o se coordinan con las empresas de mantenimiento eléctrico. Así pues, para el empresario que considere adecuada la especialidad que recomienda Berto, el ejemplo servirá de guía para averiguar si atenderá tanto las instalaciones como sus averías. Si opta por esta última opción, el empresario plomero debe calcular el número de kilómetros que recorrerá diariamente para llegar al lugar de trabajo, así como el tiempo máximo que estará fuera de su negocio, si es independiente. La formación profesional para plomeros ofrecida por la enseñanza oficial incluye el título de Fabricación y Montaje, de 2.000 horas, de Formación Profesional Básica. Su programa incluye el montaje de tuberías y la instalación de sistemas de riego automáticos a pequeña escala; no obstante, obtener este título no garantiza por sí solo poder resolver todas las cuestiones relativas a sistemas más complejos de riego automático. La demanda de profesionales y las cuentas del negocio En la información del Servicio Público de Empleo Estatal (SEPE) de fecha 17 de julio de 2026, el plomero encuentra la confirmación de las dificultades para cubrir puestos en su oficio. El organismo incluye a los fontaneros entre las ocupaciones con dificultades de cobertura y señala la falta de candidatos, experiencia y competencias técnicas entre las causas de estos desajustes. No obstante, este reconocimiento de la brecha entre la oferta y la demanda se refiere al conjunto de la ocupación, sin determinar el número de plomeros instaladores de riego que serían necesarios en una comarca concreta. La sugerencia de trabajo que hace Berto se ve limitada por el hecho de que no indica qué beneficios puede obtener la persona en relación con los gastos que tendrá que soportar. Antes de emprender, el autónomo necesita calcular los beneficios que reporta el servicio una vez deducidos los costes, algo que el testimonio no menciona. En el análisis de los ingresos de los oficios manuales, señalamos que lo que aparece en la factura del cliente es diferente al beneficio que el trabajo genera para el profesional. La construcción se ha quedado sin relevo generacional: han descubierto que nadie es albañil por vocación La modernización, tal y como se describe en la noticia de la página web del Ministerio de Agricultura de fecha 18 de septiembre de 2026, incluye las obras ya finalizadas del Canal de Macías Picavea, en Valladolid, que abarcan una superficie de 2.451 hectáreas. Se modificó la red de distribución de riego en cuanto a la sustitución de la tubería principal y las mejoras en las instalaciones eléctricas del bombeo. Para valorar el tamaño del negocio desde el punto de vista de un posible encargo, quien emprenda debe evaluar si las parcelas beneficiarias se encuentran a una distancia que pueda recorrerse diariamente. Una auditoría de las instalaciones ya existentes puede resultar útil desde el primer momento para trazar un mapa de la red de distribución que resulta relevante para el profesional que se incorpora al mercado laboral. nl.title: Purmersteijn debuteert in KNVB-beker: "Op bekeravonden gebeuren de gekste dingen"
nl.description: Een historisch moment voor Purmersteijn. Vanavond speelt de club voor het eerst in het 119-jarige clubbestaan in het hoofdtoernooi van de KNVB-beker. Voorzitter Jan Groenhart leeft toe naar de wedstrijd en is tegelijkertijd behoorlijk druk om alles in goede banen te leiden. "Er komt heel veel op ons af, maar het is een fantastisch moment voor de club." Derde divisionist Purmersteijn mag op haar debuutavond aantreden tegen een andere derde divisionist. Het Brabantse Gemert staat vanavond om 20.00 uur klaar voor de aftrap. Trainer Berry Smit treft daarmee een gelijkwaardige tegenstander. Toch had hij stiekem al een tegenstander van groter formaat gehad. "Het liefst had ik direct tegen een betaald voetbalorganisatie willen spelen. Neem bijvoorbeeld JOS Watergraafsmeer, die mochten gisteravond tegen NAC voetballen. Dat is geweldig voor iedereen binnen die amateurclub. Toch is onze loting ook mooi. Ik verwacht namelijk een gelijkopgaande strijd. Voor de zekerheid hebben we op de training alvast aandacht besteed aan het nemen van strafschoppen." Succesavond Waar Smit op het veld zijn ploeg heeft voorbereid op de wedstrijd, doet voorzitter Jan Groenhart dat achter de schermen. Om alles in goede banen te leiden besloot de club de trainingen van alle jeugdelftallen voor vanavond te schrappen. "We zijn behoorlijk druk en er komt heel veel op ons af. Rond half zes arriveert de tegenstander met vijf bussen aan supporters op ons sportpark. In totaal verwachten we tussen de twee- en drieduizend toeschouwers. Uiteindelijk willen we dat alles rond de wedstrijd soepel en ook veilig verloopt. We hebben dus alle scenario's uitgedacht." FC Lienden Waar de club Purmersteijn voor een debuut staat, heeft trainer Berry Smit al veel ervaring met het bekertoernooi. Van 2011 tot en met 2020 was de Volendammer in verschillende trainersfuncties actief bij FC Volendam. In 2015 verloren de Volendammers met 1-0 van amateurploeg FC Lienden en werden dus pijnlijk uitgeschakeld. Smit weet dus dat het bij bekervoetbal kan spoken. "Op bekeravonden gebeuren er de gekste dingen. Uit het niets staan er spelers op die zich ontpoppen tot bekerhelden. Daarnaast kan alles ook snel in de soep lopen. Pak je binnen tien minuten een rode kaart. Dan kunnen alle tactische plannen de prullenbak in en moet je simpelweg overleven. Bij bekerwedstrijden moet je nergens vanuit gaan en kan alles gebeuren." Om 20.00 uur trapt Purmersteijn vanavond op het eigen sportpark af tegen Gemert.

sg.title: Recurrent Energy Completes Sale of Two 100 MW / 400 MWh BESS Projects in France to BW ESS
sg.description: The 200 MW / 800 MWh portfolio was sold to BW ESS, demonstrating Recurrent Energy's ability to develop and monetize high-quality battery energy storage projects. KITCHENER, ON, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Recurrent Energy, a subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. ("Canadian Solar") (NASDAQ: CSIQ) and a leading global developer, owner, and operator of solar and energy storage assets, today announced the sale of two standalone BESS projects in France to BW ESS, a global energy storage owner-operator. The portfolio comprises two projects: Baixas, located in the Pyrénées-Orientales department, with a capacity of 100 MW / 400 MWh, and Coquainvilliers, located in Calvados, with a capacity of 100 MW / 400 MWh. Both projects benefit from advanced transmission-level grid connection positions and have been developed around strong grid fundamentals, including very limited expected network constraints. Together, they will provide 200 MW / 800 MWh of flexible capacity to the French electricity system. Recurrent Energy originated and developed both projects, including securing the land, advancing grid connection, and managing permitting and local stakeholder engagement. BW ESS will acquire the projects, marking the first transaction between the two companies and BW ESS' entry into the French energy market. Recurrent Energy will continue to lead the projects through the remaining development phase, drawing on its local market knowledge, technical capabilities, and experience in delivering renewable energy and storage projects. Once the remaining development milestones have been achieved, BW ESS will lead the delivery of the assets through construction and into commercial operation. BW ESS intends to own and operate the assets over the long term. Erik Strømsø, CEO and Co-Founder of BW ESS, commented: "We are excited to work with Recurrent Energy through the next phase and to apply BW ESS' long-term owner-operator expertise as we bring these assets into construction and operation. Entering France is a significant milestone for BW ESS and a natural next step in the expansion of our global energy storage platform. These acquisitions give us an immediate 200 MW / 800 MWh platform in the country and provide a strong foundation for building a sizeable French portfolio. France has a strong nuclear base, but it also has a growing need for flexibility as weather-sensitive demand and an evolving generation mix create more variable system conditions. Batteries can complement France's nuclear backbone by adding the rapid-response flexibility needed to balance the system, absorb surplus power, and make low-carbon generation available when it is most valuable." Dylan Marx, CEO of Recurrent Energy, said: "This transaction with BW ESS showcases our ability to create value through the delivery of high-quality BESS projects, while remaining closely involved in their development through to commercial operation. It is a strong testament to the BESS platform we have built in France and our ability to continue scaling it. Once operational, the projects will provide flexible storage capacity to support grid stability, balance supply and demand, and facilitate the further integration of renewable energy into the French electricity system." ABOUT BW ESS BW ESS is a global energy storage owner-operator, moving with speed to develop, deliver and operate market-leading projects. The business is active in the UK, Australia, Italy, Germany, Spain, Sweden and France. It has more than 540MWh of operating Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), with ~12GWh under / pre-construction and a development pipeline of several gigawatts. Part of BW Group, BW ESS builds on decades of global infrastructure experience, takes a long-term view of projects and partnerships, and focuses on unlocking value throughout the energy storage asset lifecycle. About Recurrent Energy Recurrent Energy, a subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc., is one of the world's largest and most geographically diversified utility-scale solar and energy storage project development, ownership, and operations platforms. With an industry-leading team of in-house energy experts, Recurrent Energy serves as Canadian Solar's global development and power services business. Additional details are available at www.recurrentenergy.com. About Canadian Solar Canadian Solar is one of the world's largest solar technology and renewable energy companies. Founded in 2001 and headquartered in Kitchener, Ontario, the Company is a leading manufacturer of solar photovoltaic modules; provider of solar energy and battery energy storage solutions; and developer, owner, and operator of utility-scale solar power and battery energy storage projects. Over the past 25 years, Canadian Solar has successfully delivered nearly 180 GW of premium-quality solar photovoltaic modules to customers across the world. Through its energy storage solutions business e-STORAGE, Canadian Solar has shipped over 23 GWh of battery energy storage solutions to global markets and had a contracted backlog of $3.5 billion as of June 30, 2026. Since entering the project development business in 2010, Canadian Solar has developed, built, and connected approximately 12.4 GWp of solar power projects and 6.4 GWh of battery energy storage projects globally. Its geographically diversified project development pipeline includes approximately 22 GWp of solar and 84 GWh of battery energy storage capacity in various stages of development. th.description: วันนี้ (29 ต.ค.2569) นายอภิชาต หรือ เอ๋ ผู้รับเหมาก่อสร้าง ชี้แจงกรณีข้อสงสัยเกี่ยวกับเส้นทางการเงินของมูลนิธิองค์กรทำดี ซึ่งมีข้อมูลว่าเงินจากบัญชี ที่เกี่ยวข้องกับมูลนิธิโอนเข้าบัญชีบริษัทผู้รับเหมา ก่อนมีเงินบางส่วนโอนต่อไปยังบัญชีของ นายอธิป หรือ ก๊อต สามีของบุ๋ม ปนัดดา วงศ์ผู้ดี นายอภิชาต อ้างว่าเงินที่ได้รับโอนเข้าบัญชีมี 2 ส่วน ส่วนแรกเป็นเงินสำหรับก่อสร้างพูลวิลล่าใน จ.ภูเก็ต ซึ่งนำไปใช้ตามงานก่อสร้างจริง ส่วนเงินอีกส่วนหนึ่งไม่ได้เกี่ยวข้องกับค่าก่อสร้าง โดยระบุว่าเมื่อได้รับแจ้งจากนายอธิปว่า มีเงินโอนเข้ามาและขอให้โอนกลับ จึงดำเนินการโอนเงินกลับไปตามที่ได้รับแจ้ง ยอมรับว่าในช่วงแรกไม่ได้สอบถามว่า เงินดังกล่าวเป็นค่าอะไร และไม่ได้เอะใจถึงความผิดปกติ แต่ในการโอนเงินครั้งต่อ ๆ มา นายอธิปขอให้จัดทำใบเสนอราคาจากบริษัทผู้รับเหมาในนามมูลนิธิองค์กรทำดี โดยไม่ได้สอบถามรายละเอียดเพิ่มเติม โดยปฏิเสธข้อกล่าวหาเรื่องการได้รับเงินทอนจากการก่อสร้าง อ่านข่าว : มูลนิธิองค์กรทำดี ให้ "บุ๋ม ปนัดดา" หยุดปฏิบัติหน้าที่ชั่วคราว พร้อมระงับรับบริจาคทุกช่องทาง "บุ๋ม ปนัดดา" เปิดใจไม่เกี่ยวที่ดินนครนายกของสามี โชว์สัญญาซื้อขาย 2.5 ล้าน ทบ. ยันดำเนินคดี "ก๊อต อธิป" รุกใช้ที่ดินรัฐ พบเพิ่งเข้าใช้พื้นที่ไม่นาน

th.title: น้ำทะเลหนุน 3 วันติด ท่วมตลาดแม่กลอง แม่ค้ารายได้หด-ร้านค้าถูกน้ำท่วม
th.description: วันนี้ (29 ต.ค.2569) สถานการณ์น้ำทะเลหนุนสูงต่อเนื่องส่งผลให้บ้านเรือน ร้านค้า ที่พัก และพื้นที่เศรษฐกิจใน จ.สมุทรสงคราม ถูกน้ำท่วม โดยเฉพาะชุมชนริมคลองอัมพวา ตลาดแม่กลอง หรือตลาดร่มหุบ และถนนหน้าวัดเพชรสมุทรวรวิหาร อ.เมืองสมุทรสงคราม หลังระดับน้ำในแม่น้ำแม่กลองและคลองสาขาสูงขึ้นจนล้นตลิ่งเข้าท่วมพื้นที่ลุ่มต่ำอย่างรวดเร็ว วรรณา เลาบัญชาชัย ชาวบ้านริมคลองอัมพวา ซึ่งอาศัยอยู่ในพื้นที่มานานกว่า 45 ปี ระบุว่า ไม่เคยพบระดับน้ำทะเลหนุนสูงเช่นครั้งนี้ โดยมองว่าระดับน้ำสูงสุดในรอบ 10 ปี และสูงกว่าช่วงน้ำท่วมปี 2554 อีกทั้งน้ำขึ้นเร็วและท่วมต่อเนื่องมาแล้ว 3 วัน ส่งผลให้ทางเดินริมคลองบางช่วงถูกน้ำท่วมจนมองไม่เห็นแนวทางเดิน ร้านค้า ที่พัก และบ้านเรือนต้องเผชิญกับน้ำที่เข้าถึงพื้นที่ใช้ชีวิตประจำวัน บริเวณตลาดแม่กลองและตลาดร่มหุบ น้ำท่วมถนนและทางเท้าหน้าร้านค้า ทำให้ประชาชนต้องเดินลุยน้ำเพื่อออกมาซื้อของ ขณะที่ผู้ประกอบการบางรายจำเป็นต้องปิดร้านชั่วคราวเพื่อป้องกันความเสียหาย อย่างไรก็ตาม รถยนต์และรถขนาดเล็กยังสามารถสัญจรผ่านพื้นที่ได้ อำพร บัวผึ้ง เจ้าของร้านจำหน่ายสังฆภัณฑ์ในตลาดแม่กลอง เปิดเผยว่า น้ำท่วมทางเท้าตั้งแต่ช่วงเช้า ทำให้ลูกค้าเดินเข้าร้านและเลือกซื้อสินค้าได้ยาก ส่งผลให้ยอดขายลดลง เหลือรายได้ประมาณวันละ 2,000 บาท ร้านค้าจึงต้องลงทุนก่อกำแพงกั้นน้ำไม่ให้ไหลเข้าพื้นที่ภายในร้าน พร้อมติดตั้งเครื่องสูบน้ำเพื่อระบายออกอย่างต่อเนื่อง ลดความเสี่ยงที่สินค้าและทรัพย์สินจะได้รับความเสียหาย แม้ผู้ประกอบการบางส่วนจะเริ่มปรับตัวกับปัญหาน้ำท่วมที่เกิดขึ้นเป็นประจำ แต่เมื่อน้ำทะเลหนุนสูงมากกว่าปกติ ผลกระทบไม่ได้จำกัดอยู่เพียงการค้าขาย ยังรบกวนการเดินทางและการใช้ชีวิตของประชาชนในชุมชนริมน้ำด้วย พื้นที่ลุ่มต่ำริมแม่น้ำแม่กลอง คลองสาขา และเขตชุมชนเมือง จ.สมุทรสงคราม จึงยังต้องเฝ้าระวังสถานการณ์น้ำทะเลหนุนต่อเนื่องไปจนถึงวันที่ 5 พ.ย. โดยมีการคาดการณ์ระดับน้ำสูงประมาณ 3.5–3.8 เมตร ประชาชนและผู้ประกอบการในพื้นที่เสี่ยงจำเป็นต้องติดตามระดับน้ำและเตรียมมาตรการป้องกันน้ำเข้าบ้านและร้านค้าอย่างใกล้ชิด อ่านข่าว : ph.title: Recurrent Energy Completes Sale of Two 100 MW / 400 MWh BESS Projects in France to BW ESS
ph.description: The 200 MW / 800 MWh portfolio was sold to BW ESS, demonstrating Recurrent Energy's ability to develop and monetize high-quality battery energy storage projects. KITCHENER, ON, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Recurrent Energy, a subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. ("Canadian Solar") (NASDAQ: CSIQ) and a leading global developer, owner, and operator of solar and energy storage assets, today announced the sale of two standalone BESS projects in France to BW ESS, a global energy storage owner-operator. The portfolio comprises two projects: Baixas, located in the Pyrénées-Orientales department, with a capacity of 100 MW / 400 MWh, and Coquainvilliers, located in Calvados, with a capacity of 100 MW / 400 MWh. Both projects benefit from advanced transmission-level grid connection positions and have been developed around strong grid fundamentals, including very limited expected network constraints. Together, they will provide 200 MW / 800 MWh of flexible capacity to the French electricity system. Recurrent Energy originated and developed both projects, including securing the land, advancing grid connection, and managing permitting and local stakeholder engagement. BW ESS will acquire the projects, marking the first transaction between the two companies and BW ESS' entry into the French energy market. Recurrent Energy will continue to lead the projects through the remaining development phase, drawing on its local market knowledge, technical capabilities, and experience in delivering renewable energy and storage projects. ph.title: ADB highlights Philippine digital payments success amid regional trade challenges
ph.description: The Philippines has emerged as a regional example of how interoperable digital payment systems can help smaller businesses participate in the digital economy, according to the Asian Development Bank (ADB), which warned that many economies across Asia-Pacific are struggling to translate digital trade agreements into tangible economic benefits. In a brief titled “Making Digital Trade Work: A Readiness Framework for Implementing Digital Trade Agreements in Asia and the Pacific” and published on Thursday, Oct. 29, the Manila-based multilateral lender highlighted the Philippines’ progress in expanding digital payments through the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas’ (BSP) National Retail Payment System (NRPS). The ADB cited the BSP’s development of the NRPS framework in 2015, which established interoperable payment systems, including InstaPay for low-value, real-time transfers and PESONet for higher-value batch payments. The report noted that digital payments accounted for 57.4 percent of monthly retail transactions by volume in 2024, up from 52.8 percent in 2023, exceeding the Philippine Development Plan’s (PDP) target. By value, the share of digital payments increased to 59 percent from 55.3 percent during the same period. InstaPay transactions also surged by 67.8 percent in volume and 46.3 percent in value in 2024, while the number of merchants accepting payments through the national QR code standard, QR Ph, jumped by 148.7 percent. The ADB said the interoperability of the Philippine payment system was critical to its success, especially in lowering the cost of digital transactions for micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs). Instead of requiring businesses to establish separate connections with individual financial institutions, the common payment standard allows participating firms and consumers to transact across the network. The ADB cited the Philippine experience as an example of how national payment infrastructure standards can encourage wider adoption of digital financial services, including among smaller businesses. However, the lender warned that many developing economies continue to face difficulties implementing digital trade agreements because of fragmented regulations, weak institutional coordination, incompatible digital infrastructure, and limited adoption among businesses. It noted that governments often adopt laws and enter into trade agreements without establishing the necessary implementing regulations, technical standards, and enforcement mechanisms. As a result, businesses may experience little improvement in compliance costs, regulatory predictability, or access to international markets despite the existence of digital trade commitments. The ADB said these implementation gaps could prevent economies from fully realizing the benefits of digital trade, including lower transaction costs, expanded market access, and greater participation by MSMEs in regional and global value chains. To address these challenges, the report introduced a Digital Trade Readiness Road Map covering policy, legal, institutional, infrastructure, and market readiness to help governments identify implementation gaps and prioritize reforms. The ADB recommended strengthening coordination among government agencies, improving cross-border compatibility of digital systems, and supporting smaller businesses in adopting electronic payments, invoicing, authentication, and other digital trade tools.

bd.description: MELBOURNE, Australia, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On October 28, HiTHIUM, a leading global energy storage technology company, showcased its ∞Power 6.9MWh 8-hour long-duration battery energy storage system (BESS) at All Energy Australia in Melbourne, alongside its grid compliance capabilities, localized service network and energy storage solutions for C&I and residential applications. HiTHIUM Showcases 8-Hour LDES Solution and Local Capabilities at All Energy Australia Long-duration energy storage is increasingly important for grid flexibility and supply reliability in Australia. The federal government supports dispatchable clean energy projects through the Capacity Investment Scheme (CIS), while New South Wales continues to advance dedicated LDES tenders, creating new opportunities for storage projects of eight hours or longer. At the exhibition, HiTHIUM showcased its ∞Power 6.9MWh 8-hour-native BESS. Australia's high-price events are lengthening, with 4-hour-plus events accounting for over 70% of scarcity revenue in 2025 and shifting storage value toward firm supply duration. CSIRO GenCost analysis shows that two 4-hour systems delivering the same 8-hour output would cost about 23% more than a purpose-built 8-hour system, which offers greater value potential during price peaks. Integrated into a standard 20-foot container, ∞Power 6.9MWh BESS offers up to 96% round-trip efficiency, a 25-year design life, and compatibility with PCS and EMS products from major global suppliers. Compared with a 4-hour configuration, it reduces land use by 15% and can lower LCOS through system optimization. Developed in line with NFPA, IEC and AS standards, the system also delivers a high level of safety. To address Australia's grid connection requirements, HiTHIUM presented its Grid Compliance Simulation and Verification Platform, supporting projects through grid connection, from R0 assessment and R1 capability assessment to commissioning and R2 model validation. By combining grid-code interpretation, plant-level modelling, automated simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing and site measurement validation, the platform helps identify potential compliance risks earlier and reduce late-stage rework. HiTHIUM continues to strengthen its localized service capabilities in Australia. The company has established a localized service network across Australia, covering spare-parts warehousing, training, operations and maintenance (O&M), and compliant battery recycling, with nationwide service coverage. At the exhibition, HiTHIUM signed strategic cooperation agreements with Raystech, Ingeteam and other Australian partners to further strengthen its local workforce, spare-parts infrastructure and safety capabilities. The company also announced that its Brisbane service center is scheduled to open by mid-2027, further expanding its regional service network and bringing efficient, reliable support closer to Australian customers. HiTHIUM also showcased its ∞Power 1022kWh liquid-cooled C&I energy storage cabinet, which combines its proprietary ∞Cell 1175Ah LDES cells with an integrated design for applications including peak shaving and solar self-consumption. For residential applications, the company presented the HeroEE 16 and ARKVOLT F8S series, supporting flexible deployment and integration with solar, heat pumps and EV charging. Through its 8-hour LDES technology, grid compliance expertise and expanding local service network, HiTHIUM is strengthening its ability to support Australian energy storage projects from development and grid connection through long-term operation. These efforts reflect HiTHIUM's commitment to supporting Australia's evolving energy storage needs with integrated solutions and sustained local support.

ae.description: The 200 MW / 800 MWh portfolio was sold to BW ESS, demonstrating Recurrent Energy's ability to develop and monetize high-quality battery energy storage projects. KITCHENER, ON, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Recurrent Energy, a subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. ("Canadian Solar") (NASDAQ: CSIQ) and a leading global developer, owner, and operator of solar and energy storage assets, today announced the sale of two standalone BESS projects in France to BW ESS, a global energy storage owner-operator. The portfolio comprises two projects: Baixas, located in the Pyrénées-Orientales department, with a capacity of 100 MW / 400 MWh, and Coquainvilliers, located in Calvados, with a capacity of 100 MW / 400 MWh. Both projects benefit from advanced transmission-level grid connection positions and have been developed around strong grid fundamentals, including very limited expected network constraints. Together, they will provide 200 MW / 800 MWh of flexible capacity to the French electricity system. Recurrent Energy originated and developed both projects, including securing the land, advancing grid connection, and managing permitting and local stakeholder engagement. BW ESS will acquire the projects, marking the first transaction between the two companies and BW ESS' entry into the French energy market. Recurrent Energy will continue to lead the projects through the remaining development phase, drawing on its local market knowledge, technical capabilities, and experience in delivering renewable energy and storage projects. Once the remaining development milestones have been achieved, BW ESS will lead the delivery of the assets through construction and into commercial operation. BW ESS intends to own and operate the assets over the long term. Erik Strømsø, CEO and Co-Founder of BW ESS, commented: "We are excited to work with Recurrent Energy through the next phase and to apply BW ESS' long-term owner-operator expertise as we bring these assets into construction and operation. Entering France is a significant milestone for BW ESS and a natural next step in the expansion of our global energy storage platform. These acquisitions give us an immediate 200 MW / 800 MWh platform in the country and provide a strong foundation for building a sizeable French portfolio. France has a strong nuclear base, but it also has a growing need for flexibility as weather-sensitive demand and an evolving generation mix create more variable system conditions. Batteries can complement France's nuclear backbone by adding the rapid-response flexibility needed to balance the system, absorb surplus power, and make low-carbon generation available when it is most valuable." Once operational, the projects will provide flexible storage capacity to support grid stability, balance supply and demand, and facilitate the further integration of renewable energy into the French electricity system." ae.title: Arab Reading Challenge Champion: Dubai is the city of dreams, and winning the title is the greatest crowning achievement
ae.description: From her school library, where her story with poetry and words began, to the podium in Dubai, her small dreams turned into a great achievement. The Egyptian girl, Mayar Othman El Shorbagy, wrote an exceptional success story with books after she was crowned champion of the “Arab Reading Challenge 2026” in its tenth edition, becoming one of the inspiring role models for children who made reading a path to excellence, after a journey during which she read more than 70 books, exceeding the number required to participate in the challenge, and confirming that her winning the title represents a new beginning in her journey with knowledge, and not its end. In a special statement, Mayar Othman El Shorbagy, the champion of the tenth edition of the Arab Reading Challenge, thanked His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, who gave the children of the world the opportunity to become heroes of knowledge through the Arab Reading Challenge initiative. She noted that the moment she was declared the winner was one of the happiest moments of her life, as she felt that every book she read and every hour she spent among the pages had turned into an achievement she was proud of, stressing that the challenge changed her view of reading, and made her realize that a book is not just pages that you finish, but new worlds that you discover every day. She explained that she had read more than 70 books, including 50 books within the challenge passports, but she continued reading after completing the required number, because her relationship with the book had become greater than any competition or prize. She added: “I was reading to participate in the challenge, but I discovered that I read because I love books, and I feel that every book adds something new to my personality, and makes me more able to understand life and express my thoughts. I have completed the challenge passports, and I won the title, but my journey with reading will not end.” Dubai, the city of dreams Mayar confirmed that winning the title of Arab Reading Challenge champion brought her double the joy, as she had achieved her dream in a city that had always been associated in her imagination with success, ambition, and achievement. She said, “Dubai is a city of dreams for me, a city that makes a child feel that their dream, no matter how small, can become a big reality. I came here carrying a love of reading and a dream of winning, and today I return carrying the title of Arab Reading Challenge champion, an achievement I will cherish for the rest of my life.” She explained that being among children from different countries around the world in the challenge competitions, united by a shared passion for books and knowledge, made the experience exceptional. She clarified that Dubai not only brought together competitors for a title, but also brought together their dreams and ambitions, and gave them an opportunity to showcase their talents and abilities to the world. Mayar noted that the moment her victory was announced will remain etched in her memory, after feelings of anticipation and waiting turned into great joy, stressing that the title carries for her the responsibility of encouraging more children to read and take pride in the Arabic language. Unique leader Mayar expressed her pride in the initiative launched by His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, stressing that His Highness gave millions of children an exceptional opportunity to discover their talents and prove their abilities through reading, and made the book a means to create heroes and build the future. She added, “His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum didn’t just give us a reading competition; he gave us a grand dream, making books a path to success and giving children the opportunity to become heroes through science and knowledge. I feel proud that there is a leader who believes that a child who reads today can shape the future tomorrow.” She continued, “The most beautiful message I learned from the Arab Reading Challenge is that knowledge is true power, and that the Arabic language deserves our pride, our reading, and our creativity. I hope this initiative reaches every child in the world because books can change a person’s life and open doors they never imagined.” She emphasized that winning the title in the tenth edition strengthened her belief that reading can transform children’s lives and that initiatives that invest in the minds of future generations give them real opportunities to discover their abilities and achieve their dreams. Discovering talent Mayar reminisced about the beginning of her journey, explaining that the school librarian was the first to discover her talent and encourage her to participate in the challenge after hearing her recite poetry and speak fluent and passionate Arabic. She continued, "My supervisor saw something special in me before I even realized it myself. She listened to me recite poetry and speak, and told me that anyone with such a passion for words deserved to be a star in the Arab Reading Challenge. From that moment, I began to believe that I could achieve my dream." Mayar affirmed that the words of encouragement she received from her supervisor were a turning point in her life, motivating her to read more widely, seek out diverse books, and develop her comprehension, analytical, and expressive abilities, until reading became an indispensable daily habit. She explained that winning the title brought back memories of the initial moments when the library supervisor encouraged her to participate, noting that discovering and nurturing children's talents at the right time can open wide doors to success for them. Coronation joy Regarding her feelings after being declared the winner of the “Arab Reading Challenge” in its tenth edition, Mayar said: “Winning the “Arab Reading Challenge” is not just a title or an award, but rather a culmination of every book I have read, every hour I have spent among the pages, and every person who believed in my talent and encouraged me to continue. I feel that I have achieved a great dream, but at the same time I realize that my journey with knowledge is still in its early stages.” She continued, “I want to tell every child that dreams don’t need to be old to come true; they only require willpower, passion, and self-belief. My journey began with encouragement from my school librarian, and today I stand in Dubai as the champion of the Arab Reading Challenge, carrying an even bigger dream: to continue reading and to be a role model who encourages children to love books.” She noted that winning the title gave her greater motivation to continue reading and to develop her Arabic language and poetry recitation skills. She added that she looks forward to using her experience to encourage her classmates and peers to discover the joy of reading and not to see it as just a school assignment or a way to win prizes.

ae.title: HiTHIUM Showcases 8-Hour LDES Solution and Local Capabilities at All Energy Australia
ae.description: MELBOURNE, Australia, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On October 28, HiTHIUM, a leading global energy storage technology company, showcased its ∞Power 6.9MWh 8-hour long-duration battery energy storage system (BESS) at All Energy Australia in Melbourne, alongside its grid compliance capabilities, localized service network and energy storage solutions for C&I and residential applications. HiTHIUM Showcases 8-Hour LDES Solution and Local Capabilities at All Energy Australia Long-duration energy storage is increasingly important for grid flexibility and supply reliability in Australia. The federal government supports dispatchable clean energy projects through the Capacity Investment Scheme (CIS), while New South Wales continues to advance dedicated LDES tenders, creating new opportunities for storage projects of eight hours or longer. At the exhibition, HiTHIUM showcased its ∞Power 6.9MWh 8-hour-native BESS. Australia's high-price events are lengthening, with 4-hour-plus events accounting for over 70% of scarcity revenue in 2025 and shifting storage value toward firm supply duration. CSIRO GenCost analysis shows that two 4-hour systems delivering the same 8-hour output would cost about 23% more than a purpose-built 8-hour system, which offers greater value potential during price peaks. Integrated into a standard 20-foot container, ∞Power 6.9MWh BESS offers up to 96% round-trip efficiency, a 25-year design life, and compatibility with PCS and EMS products from major global suppliers. Compared with a 4-hour configuration, it reduces land use by 15% and can lower LCOS through system optimization. Developed in line with NFPA, IEC and AS standards, the system also delivers a high level of safety. To address Australia's grid connection requirements, HiTHIUM presented its Grid Compliance Simulation and Verification Platform, supporting projects through grid connection, from R0 assessment and R1 capability assessment to commissioning and R2 model validation. By combining grid-code interpretation, plant-level modelling, automated simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing and site measurement validation, the platform helps identify potential compliance risks earlier and reduce late-stage rework. HiTHIUM continues to strengthen its localized service capabilities in Australia. The company has established a localized service network across Australia, covering spare-parts warehousing, training, operations and maintenance (O&M), and compliant battery recycling, with nationwide service coverage. At the exhibition, HiTHIUM signed strategic cooperation agreements with Raystech, Ingeteam and other Australian partners to further strengthen its local workforce, spare-parts infrastructure and safety capabilities. The company also announced that its Brisbane service center is scheduled to open by mid-2027, further expanding its regional service network and bringing efficient, reliable support closer to Australian customers. HiTHIUM also showcased its ∞Power 1022kWh liquid-cooled C&I energy storage cabinet, which combines its proprietary ∞Cell 1175Ah LDES cells with an integrated design for applications including peak shaving and solar self-consumption. For residential applications, the company presented the HeroEE 16 and ARKVOLT F8S series, supporting flexible deployment and integration with solar, heat pumps and EV charging. Through its 8-hour LDES technology, grid compliance expertise and expanding local service network, HiTHIUM is strengthening its ability to support Australian energy storage projects from development and grid connection through long-term operation. These efforts reflect HiTHIUM's commitment to supporting Australia's evolving energy storage needs with integrated solutions and sustained local support.

iq.title: محافظ بابل من قلب المدينة الأثرية: 90% من آثار المحافظة لم تُكتشف بعدُ
iq.description: شفق نيوز - بابل أكد محافظ بابل الحقوقي علي تركي الچمالي، اليوم الخميس، أن محافظة بابل تمتلك إرثاً حضارياً وتاريخياً استثنائياً، لا يزال جزءاً كبيراً منه غير مكتشف، مشدداً على أهمية تعزيز التعاون الدولي لاستكشاف المواقع الأثرية وصيانتها والحفاظ عليها. جاء ذلك خلال لقائه ممثلة بعثة الاتحاد الأوروبي ومنظمة الأمم المتحدة للتربية والعلم والثقافة (اليونسكو)، "هنريكه ترا أو تمان"، حسب ما ذكره بيان صادر عن محافظة بابل. وقال الچمالي إن المكتشف من مدينة بابل الأثرية لا يتجاوز نحو 10% من إجمالي مساحتها، ما يفتح آفاقاً واسعة أمام البعثات التنقيبية والمشاريع العلمية، مؤكداً أن المحافظة تمتلك بعض الإمكانيات، لكنها تتطلع إلى دعم الاتحاد الأوروبي في أعمال التنقيب والترميم وحماية المواقع التاريخية. وأشار إلى أن بابل تنعم باستقرار أمني مستمر منذ سنوات، داعياً الوفود الأوروبية إلى نقل الصورة الحقيقية عن الواقع الأمني في المحافظة، وتشجيع شعوب بلدانهم على زيارة بابل والاطلاع على حضارتها ومعالمها التاريخية، التي تمثل جزءاً مهماً من الإرث الإنساني العالمي. ورحب المحافظ بزيارة الوفود الرسمية والشركات الاستثمارية والمعمارية، مؤكداً استعداد الحكومة المحلية لتوفير الدعم والتسهيلات اللازمة أمام الفرص الاستثمارية المتاحة في قطاعات الزراعة والصناعة والإعمار، إلى جانب تعزيز الشراكات الدولية المعنية بحماية الآثار وإحياء المواقع التراثية في بابل والعراق. من جانبها، أكدت "هنريكه ترا أو تمان" أن هناك أعمالاً وبعثات ومشاريع تنفذ في عدد من المحافظات العراقية، مشيرة إلى وجود خطط لمشاريع مستقبلية، فيما حضرت اللقاء السيدة كريستينا متغلافيتشالو، رئيسة الفرق في العراق. ويأتي اللقاء في إطار تعزيز التعاون مع المؤسسات الدولية والبعثات المتخصصة، بما يسهم في حماية الإرث الحضاري لبابل، وتحويل ثروتها التاريخية إلى رافد ثقافي وسياحي وتنموي للمحافظة والعراق.

iq.description: شفق نيوز - بغداد سجلت السعة الكلية لشبكة النفاذ الضوئي (FTTH) في العراق ارتفاعاً خلال عام 2025، بالتزامن مع استمرار نمو خدمات الاتصالات والإنترنت، فيما حافظ عدد المكاتب البريدية على مستواه المسجل في العام السابق. وبحسب تقرير إحصاءات الاتصالات والبريد لعام 2025، الصادر عن مديرية إحصاءات النقل والاتصالات، بلغت السعة الكلية لشبكة النفاذ الضوئي 4.8574 ملايين خط، مقارنة بـ3.4396 ملايين خط في عام 2024، بارتفاع نسبته 41.2%. وأظهرت البيانات أن محافظة بغداد سجلت أعلى كثافة هاتفية لشبكة النفاذ الضوئي، بواقع 21.2 لكل 100 شخص، تلتها محافظة كركوك بنسبة 18.1%، ثم ميسان بنسبة 14.5%، فيما بلغت الكثافة الهاتفية للشبكة على مستوى العراق، باستثناء إقليم كوردستان، 12.3 لكل 100 شخص. وفي قطاع الاتصالات، بلغ عدد المشتركين في خطوط الهاتف النقال للشركات العاملة في العراق، بما فيها إقليم كوردستان، باستثناء شركة كورك، 41.9 مليون مشترك خلال عام 2025، فيما بلغت الكثافة الهاتفية لهذه الخطوط 90.8 لكل 100 شخص. كما بلغ عدد المشتركين في خدمة الإنترنت عبر الهاتف النقال للشركات العاملة في العراق، باستثناء شركة كورك، 24 مليون مشترك، في حين بلغ عدد المشتركين الفعليين في خطوط الهاتف اللاسلكي التابعة للشركة العامة للاتصالات والمعلوماتية (شركة النخيل) 526 ألف مشترك. وفي قطاع البريد، بلغ عدد المكاتب البريدية في العراق 277 مكتباً خلال عام 2025، وهو العدد نفسه المسجل في عام 2024. وبلغ إجمالي الطرود البريدية الدولية 9,578 طرداً، منها 7,274 طرداً وارداً و2,304 طرود صادرة. أما عدد المودعين في صناديق التوفير في العراق، فانخفض إلى 72 ألف مودع خلال عام 2025، مقارنة بـ81 ألف مودع في عام 2024، بتراجع نسبته 11.1%.

za.title: LGE 2026: Knysna residents call for urgent water and sanitation upgrades
za.description: LGE 2026: Knysna residents call for urgent water and sanitation upgrades Estelle. Bronkhorst Thu, 10/29/2026 - 13:00 KNYSNA - Housing shortages and persistent sewage spills are among the biggest challenges facing residents in Knysna ahead of the 2026 Local Government Elections. Resident Jovan Maritz says the lack of housing over the past 15 to 20 years has forced people to build homes in areas not equipped to accommodate them, placing additional strain on an ageing sewage infrastructure. Maritz says the municipality’s sewerage pipes have not kept pace with the town’s growth, with infrastructure in some areas reportedly last upgraded during apartheid. “All the political parties that have governed Knysna are part of the problem. They always make the surface look good here in Knysna, but underneath, it is absolutely rotten,” Maritz says. Water shortages are another major concern. Maritz says the community went without water for three months and alleges that water supplies are sometimes interrupted during storms, while water tankers appear in the area. Residents want reliable access to clean running water, urgent upgrades to sewage infrastructure and more housing. Maritz also expressed concern about the health risks posed by sewage spills, particularly for children, warning of the potential spread of diseases such as cholera. Despite the challenges, Maritz says there is little faith that the upcoming elections will bring immediate change. Instead, they hope the community will unite and hold the incoming leadership accountable during its first 100 days in office. “At the end of the day, we forget this is our tax money that they are using to help us. They are public servants, and they seem to forget that,” Maritz says.
